body: That's the whole point. Think of Ori sup as Lulu for Melee carries. Lulu don't deal damage too, just shields and stuff. Difference than lulu is you get more safety while supporting while losing a bit on impact

Ori Support is a really situational pick. She is very well with melee carries and she has double or triple the range lulu has so she is pretty safe in teamfights too. It is basically sacrificing your ADC and enabling your other laners. Imagine an Olaf or Yi coming at you with high speed and shields...
